benchmark_review.reason: The frozen questions request an entity-level measure but do not always enumerate an exact output projection or prohibit visible display attributes. This is a contract-clarity risk, not proof that the semantic targets are wrong.

dominant_failure_family.evidence: Seven outputs add display or diagnostic columns while preserving the requested relational and metric logic; all seven fail first at result-column validation.

governance.statement: Observed failures are downstream of governed task classification.

detector_assessment.OUTPUT_SHAPE_ERROR: PARTIALLY_DETECTABLE without an explicit requested-column contract; detectable once the projection contract is explicit.
detector_assessment.JSON_TYPE_COERCION_ERROR: DETECTABLE from visible attribute type plus generated expression typing.

architecture_implication.label: MIXED, dominated by output-contract/projection discipline
architecture_implication.explanation: The eight cases do not primarily indicate missing context, relationship grounding, aggregation/grain, or temporal failure. Seven are projection-contract failures and one is a visible JSON type-coercion failure.

sample_caveat: This is an 8-failure forensic sample from a 30-case development pilot. It identifies mechanisms to test next; it does not prove population-wide failure rates.
